violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED SEARED AHI TUNA IN THE 6-DRAWER PREP TOP COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. EHS DISCUSSED REQUIREMENTS OF A NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS WITH THE PIC. PIC DISCARDED OF AHI TUNA DURING INSPECTION AND AGREED TO DISCONTINUE THE NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS AND SEAR AHI TUNA PER ORDER.
